title: Heat Check, Week 8
dek: Colston Loveland's targets went 5, 7, 12. The stove's on in Chicago.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Tue 7:45 PM ET: rest-of-season ranks refreshed throughout; the calls stand. Updated Tue 7:35 PM ET: D'Andre Swift played 54 snaps vs NE, not 59; he is still RB10 rest of season for me, so hold him.

Heat Check is about direction, not box scores. A riser earned more of the ball week over week or took a role you can see in the snap counts; a faller is losing snaps, routes or targets. One number backs each call, ranks are rest of season for me, and the scoring is PPR. Week 8 lineup ranks come with Wednesday's Menu.

risers.why: Colston Loveland (CHI) led Chicago with 12 targets vs NE and caught 7 for 69 and a TD on 84 percent of the snaps. His share has climbed three straight games, and Cole Kmet's knee injury is season-ending.
risers.verdict: TE6 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2.

risers.why: Tre Tucker (LV) caught 5 of 12 targets for 103 and a TD vs LAR on 82 percent of the snaps. Last week's sell was on two touchdowns from 7 targets; the targets have caught up since.
risers.verdict: WR40 rest of season for me, and the targets say higher. Claim him, 4 to 8 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: KC Concepcion Jr. (CLE) caught 8 of 10 targets for 129 at TEN on 79 percent of the snaps, the most targets on the Browns, and added 3 carries for 23.
risers.verdict: WR37 rest of season for me. Add him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: Makai Lemon (PHI) caught 7 of 8 targets for 67 and a TD vs DAL Monday with DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks out, his best game as a pro. His snap share has climbed from 70 percent in Week 3 to 91 percent.
risers.verdict: WR50 rest of season for me. Add him, 2 to 5 percent of FAAB, before Smith's Wednesday practice report.

risers.stat: 38 snaps to Aaron Jones Sr.'s 15 in his first game off IR
risers.why: Jordan Mason (MIN) ran 15 times for 68 vs IND and led the backs before Aaron Jones Sr. aggravated the MCL sprain in his left knee. Jones is day to day.
risers.verdict: RB26 rest of season for me. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.

risers.stat: 49% of the snaps off IR, the most of any Denver back
risers.why: Jonah Coleman (DEN) played 30 snaps at ARI and ran 9 times for 54 with 2 catches, while J.K. Dobbins played 14 and RJ Harvey 16.
risers.verdict: RB27 rest of season for me. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

risers.stat: Snap share 58% and 58%, then 54 snaps in Week 7; carries 9, 16, 22
risers.why: D'Andre Swift (CHI) played 54 snaps vs NE to Roschon Johnson's 10 and ran 22 times for 78 and a TD with Kyle Monangai out a third game. Johnson took 2 carries. Monangai's return to practice is what would change the call.
risers.verdict: RB10 rest of season for me. Hold him; do not sell into Monangai's return.

risers.why: Ollie Gordon II (MIA) ran 25 times for 103 and a TD at NYJ in Miami's first win. Jaylen Wright played 8 snaps before a quad injury.
risers.verdict: RB19 rest of season for me. Add him, 2 to 5 percent of FAAB.

risers.stat: 3 TD passes in each of the last two games, 0 INTs in three
risers.why: Michael Penix Jr. (ATL) went 25 of 34 for 213 and 3 TDs vs SF after 3 TDs at CHI, with no interception in his last three games. Atlanta plays at TB Sunday.
risers.verdict: QB18 rest of season for me. Add him in superflex, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: Alvin Kamara (NO) out-snapped Kendre Miller 32 to 22 vs PIT and caught all 7 of his targets for 57 through a back injury. New Orleans is on bye in Week 8; Miller back over 30 snaps is what would change the call.
risers.verdict: RB40 rest of season for me. Hold him through the bye.

risers.why: Elic Ayomanor (TEN) drew 7 targets vs CLE, 23 percent of the throws, after 2 in each of the two games before, and caught 3 for 44 with Calvin Ridley inactive.
risers.verdict: WR98 rest of season for me. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: Ryan Flournoy (DAL) caught all 4 targets for 70 at PHI and has out-targeted Jake Ferguson 13 to 4 over the last two games as the third option behind CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens.
risers.verdict: WR60 rest of season for me. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

fallers.why: Garrett Wilson (NYJ) caught 2 of 3 targets for 26 vs MIA on 85 percent of the snaps, while Omar Cooper Jr. caught 5 for 115 and a TD. Aaron Glenn put the missing targets on himself.
fallers.verdict: WR17 rest of season for me. Monitor; his targets vs LV Sunday.

fallers.why: Sam LaPorta (DET) played 97 percent of the snaps vs GB and caught 1 of 2 targets for 18, while Amon-Ra St. Brown drew 11 and Jameson Williams 9.
fallers.verdict: TE5 rest of season for me. Monitor; his targets vs MIN Sunday.

fallers.why: Isaiah Likely (NYG) caught 2 of 4 targets at HOU in J.J. McCarthy's first start, after 24 targets over the two weeks before. New York is on bye in Week 8.
fallers.verdict: TE4 rest of season for me. Monitor; his targets at PHI in Week 9.
fallers.watch: his targets at PHI in Week 9

fallers.why: Germie Bernard (PIT) caught 3 of 5 for 27 vs NO on 91 percent of the snaps, while Rico Dowdle drew 6 targets out of the backfield.
fallers.verdict: WR42 rest of season for me. Monitor; his targets vs CLE Sunday.

fallers.why: Kyren Williams (LAR) ran 16 times for 99 and a TD at LV, but Blake Corum played 44 percent of the snaps and had 6 carries in the red zone. The Rams led 28-6 at halftime.
fallers.verdict: RB7 rest of season for me. Monitor; the snap split vs LAC Sunday.
fallers.watch: the snap split vs LAC Sunday

fallers.why: Aaron Jones Sr. (MIN) played 15 snaps vs IND behind Jordan Mason before he aggravated the MCL sprain in his left knee. Adam Schefter reported it is not considered significant.
fallers.verdict: RB33 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's Vikings injury report.

fallers.why: Chuba Hubbard (CAR) ran 7 times for 33 in the 43-13 loss to TB, a week after 28 carries at PHI. Most of the drop was the score; he still caught 4 of 5 targets.
fallers.verdict: RB11 rest of season for me. Monitor; his carries at GB Thursday night.
fallers.watch: his carries at GB Thursday night

fallers.stat: 14 of 27 for 163, pulled in the fourth quarter
fallers.why: Bryce Young (CAR) threw 2 interceptions and was sacked 5 times vs TB before Kenny Pickett finished the game. He was a full participant on Monday's estimated report, and Dave Canales gave no reason beyond the score.
fallers.verdict: QB15 rest of season for me. Monitor; Canales' word on Thursday's starter.
fallers.watch: Dave Canales' word on Thursday's starter

fallers.stat: Snap share 16%, 24%, 24%; 13 snaps and 3 carries at CHI
fallers.why: TreVeyon Henderson (NE) played a season-low 13 snaps at CHI, and Mike Vrabel said he wants Corey Kiner to get carries too. Rhamondre Stevenson played 69 percent.
fallers.verdict: RB38 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR with a weekly role.
fallers.price: a bench WR with a weekly role

fallers.why: J.K. Dobbins (DEN) played 14 snaps at ARI behind Jonah Coleman and ran 6 times for 23. His TD came on the only carry he had inside the 5.
fallers.verdict: RB42 rest of season for me. Drop him for Coleman or any add on the list.

fallers.why: Mike Washington Jr. (LV) played 18 snaps vs LAR and ran 6 times for 27, while Ashton Jeanty went back up to 72 percent. Last week's claim was on half the early downs, and that share went back to Jeanty.
fallers.verdict: RB45 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

fallers.why: Kendre Miller (NO) played 22 snaps to Alvin Kamara's 32 vs PIT, and New Orleans ran 17 times for 18 yards. The Saints are on bye in Week 8.
fallers.verdict: RB50 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

fallers.why: Jake Ferguson (DAL) did not catch his one target at PHI, and Brevyn Spann-Ford has taken the inline snaps since Week 6. Ferguson has not topped 43 yards in a game this season.
fallers.verdict: TE28 rest of season for me. Drop him for any tight end on the list.

fallers.why: Juwan Johnson (NO) has 1 catch for 7 yards over the last two games, on 58 and 56 percent of the snaps. New Orleans is on bye in Week 8.
fallers.verdict: TE17 rest of season for me. Drop him for any tight end on the list.

fallers.stat: 3 targets on 74% of the snaps; share 12%, 12%, 10%
fallers.why: Tyler Higbee (LAR) caught 2 of 3 for 14 at LV, while Colby Parkinson drew 6 targets and Davis Allen caught 2 TDs. Three tight ends are splitting the work with Davante Adams out.
fallers.verdict: TE24 rest of season for me. Drop him for any tight end on the list.
